correctness.rationale: For fixed \(x\), property \((M)\) transfers the limsup of \(\|x+e_n\|\) to the explicit vector \(\|x\|e_0+e_n\). The explicit recursion gives \(L_c(\|x\|)=\max\{1,\sqrt{\|x\|^2+c^2}\}\). Reapplying the argument to every subsequence upgrades limsup to a genuine limit. The same calculation at \(D_cx\), together with \(d_n\to1\), gives the exact limit ratio for \(\|D_cu_n(x)\|\). Contractivity proves the inside-ball direction and Proposition 4.1 supplies the strict inequality needed outside the ball. The weak limit follows because the denominator tends to one and \(e_n\) is weakly null.

value.rationale: The focal WMP failure is witnessed in print by one nonzero weak limit. The new claim shows that the same non-norm-attaining operator realizes every point of a macroscopic infinite-dimensional closed ball as a weak limit of explicit maximizing sequences, and it identifies the exact radius for a natural one-spike family. This quantitatively strengthens the geometric picture of the counterexample rather than merely varying a parameter.
